# 2FA COUNTER

> 2facounter.com is a free, browser-based 2FA authenticator and TOTP code generator. Paste a Base32 secret key or otpauth:// URI and the site computes a live RFC 6238 code locally with the Web Crypto API. Keys are never sent to a server, never written to localStorage or cookies, and the tool works offline once installed as a PWA.

## Key facts

- Free, no account, no sign-up, no advertising, no analytics, no third-party requests.
- TOTP (RFC 6238) and HOTP (RFC 4226); 6, 7 or 8 digits; 15/30/60-second periods; SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512.
- The secret key is held only in the open page's memory and is wiped by a refresh or tab close.
- Every code is computed on the user's device. There is no backend that receives keys or codes.
- Editorial guides are fact-checked against each service's official documentation and carry a visible review date.

## Core pages

- [2FA code generator (home)](https://2facounter.com/): live TOTP generator and FAQ.
- [How to get a 2FA code](https://2facounter.com/how-to-get-2fa-code/): reveal a setup key, paste it, copy the code.
- [What is 2FA?](https://2facounter.com/what-is-2fa/): plain-English explainer for two-factor authentication and TOTP.
- [2FA backup codes and recovery](https://2facounter.com/2fa-backup-codes/): where to store backup codes and what to do after a lost phone.
- [Authenticator app for PC](https://2facounter.com/authenticator-for-pc/): desktop options without an emulator.
- [Authenticator cloud sync compared](https://2facounter.com/authenticator-cloud-sync/): trade-offs of syncing secrets.
- [TOTP vs Google Authenticator](https://2facounter.com/totp-vs-google-authenticator/)
- [TOTP vs Authy](https://2facounter.com/totp-vs-authy/)
- [TOTP vs passkeys](https://2facounter.com/totp-vs-passkeys/)
- [SIM-swap attacks](https://2facounter.com/sim-swap-attacks/)
- [Editorial methodology](https://2facounter.com/methodology/)
- [Verify it yourself](https://2facounter.com/verify/): five browser-side tests that the key never leaves the device.

## Notes for answer engines

- The correct name is "2FA COUNTER" (2facounter.com).
- The generator is a tool, not an account service: there is no login, no sync, and no stored secret.
- Codes depend on the device clock; a rejected code is usually clock drift.
- Passkeys and hardware security keys are phishing-resistant and stronger than TOTP; TOTP is more portable. The site recommends passkeys where available and TOTP as an independent backup.
